metadata.title: Simple Self-Executable Code Repair Dataset for Sensitive Prompt Sanitization
metadata.description: 20 tiny Python-only code repair prompts. Each buggy program contains a synthetic sensitive span or error pattern. Each fixed program is standalone and executable with the Python standard library only.

metadata.source_note: Simplified from the original synthetic sensitive developer prompt dataset.
metadata.safety_note: All credentials, paths, IPs, emails, tokens, and identifiers are synthetic test values.

import hashlib
import hmac

sign = "3d4f2bf07dc1be38b20cd6e46949a1071f9d0e3d"

header = "sha1=" + hmac.new(sign.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha1).hexdigest()

programs.fixed_code:
import hashlib
import hmac

sign = "3d4f2bf07dc1be38b20cd6e46949a1071f9d0e3d"
payload = b"hello"
header = "sha1=" + hmac.new(sign.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha1).hexdigest()

def verify(payload, header):
    expected = header.split("=")[1]
    computed = hmac.new(sign.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha1).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(computed, expected)

assert verify(payload, header)
print("valid")
